description: Makes one image of a set again with the same prompt, as 1–5 new versions next to the old ones, to pick the best (pick_image_version). Each version costs the original image’s credits (usually 1). Not for the main image on white (a cut-out of the photo); use edit_image for that. Returns the new generation ids; then call get_image_set.

versions.description: New versions to make at once (default 1)

name: regenerate_image
title: Make an image again
